metadata.description: AI job application assistant: reads your CV, scores it against job descriptions, runs mock interviews and writes cover letters.

home.title: From CV to offer — faster and with confidence
home.description: Upload your CV and let AI fill in your profile, score it against each job description, run mock interviews and draft your cover letters.

parse.title: Reads any CV
parse.description: PDF, DOCX or a photo — AI reads it and pre-fills your profile in seconds.

match.title: CV vs job description
match.description: See missing skills at a glance and how to improve each section of your CV.

interview.title: Mock interviews
interview.description: Practise with an AI recruiter and get feedback on every answer.

errors.COMMON_INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.COMMON_VALIDATION_FAILED: Some information is invalid. Please check and try again.
errors.COMMON_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors.COMMON_RATE_LIMITED: You're going too fast. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.AUTH_FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.AUTH_EMAIL_TAKEN: This email is already in use.
errors.AUTH_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your email before signing in.
errors.AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED: This link has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked. Please contact an administrator.
errors.AUTH_PASSWORD_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: This account's password can't be changed in the app.
errors.AUTH_EMAIL_ALREADY_VERIFIED: This email is already verified. You can sign in.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.ONBOARDING_REQUIRED: Please complete your profile to continue.
errors.COMMON_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (max 10 MB).
errors.COMMON_UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: Only PDF, DOCX, PNG, JPG or WEBP files are supported.
errors.RESUME_PARSE_FAILED: AI couldn’t read this CV. Try another file or fill in your details yourself.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service is busy. Please try again in a few minutes or fill in your details yourself.
errors.ANALYSIS_FAILED: AI could not analyse this CV against the job description. Try again or use another CV.
errors.STREAM_INTERRUPTED: The connection dropped while AI was writing. Please try again.

dashboard.subtitle: Which job are you applying for today?
dashboard.ctaTitle: Compare your CV with a job posting
dashboard.ctaBody: Paste a job description and AI will score the fit, list missing skills and suggest how to improve your CV.

analyses.title: Compare your CV with a job posting
